purpose: Non-inferiority check for H4 with the paired t-test added next to the shifted Wilcoxon (same flaw as deviation D1 of the twelve-idea study). investigation.json stays the frozen run used by the paper; this is a separate run of the same script on the corpus as it was at run time.

H4.test: non-inferiority, H0: hk1 worse than cosine by more than 0.03; p is the larger of a one-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test and a one-sided paired t-test on (hk1 minus cosine plus 0.03)
